summary: Introduces a sample setup for automating a web service that organizes playbooks, roles, inventory and variable files by function, with tags for finer control.
questions: How should I organize an Ansible project for a web service?
Is there a recommended example Ansible project structure?

answer_card.title: Sample Ansible setup overview
answer_card.answer_md: The sample setup organizes playbooks, roles, inventory and variable files **by function**, and uses tags at play and task level for finer control. It is one flexible approach; adapt it to your needs.
